filters.title: CONTROL PANEL
filters.genre_or_hint: (Selecting multiple expands the catalog with any of those genres)
filters.min_votes_hint: Minimum votes keep out movies rated 9.0 by two people. Set 0 to include 100% of TMDB.
filters.search_active_hint: Title search active: other filters won't apply until you clear it.

watched.title: WATCHED MOVIES
watched.empty: You haven't marked any movies as watched yet.
watched.empty_hint: Right-click any movie card in the catalog or draw modal and select "Watched ✔".

history.title: DRAW HISTORY
history.empty_hint: Every time you click "RANDOM DRAW MOVIE", the results will be automatically saved here in your history.

api_modal.title: API KEY CONFIGURATION
api_modal.description: Enter your free The Movie Database (TMDB) API v3 key to access over 1,000,000+ movies.
api_modal.omdb_description: IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic ratings already work out of the box with the official key. Optionally, you can use your own free OMDb API key.
api_modal.omdb_get_key_link: Get a free OMDb API key
api_modal.youtube_description: Add your own free YouTube Data API key so that, while viewing a movie's card, its theme song or a classic scene is searched and played in the background. Without a key (or if nothing is found), the trailer's audio plays instead. The free quota is small (~100 searches/day), so your own key is more reliable.
api_modal.youtube_get_key_link: Get a free key on Google Cloud (YouTube Data API v3)
api_modal.add_official_demo: Use the official demo API key

errors.no_results: No movies found matching your current filters.
errors.no_results_hint: Try loosening your filters (expand year range, lower minimum rating, or remove actor).
errors.no_key: A TMDB API Key is required to perform searches.
errors.details_failed: Couldn't load the movie details. Please try again.

catalog.page_cap_hint: (Max. 500 pages per filter out of 1,000,000+ movies on TMDB)

login.purpose: A profile puts a name and avatar on this browser's watched list and history. It's optional.
login.google_unavailable: Couldn't load the Google button (script blocker?). You can use a local profile instead.
login.google_error: Google didn't return a valid identity. Try again or use a local profile.
login.google_disclaimer: Google verifies your identity and shares your name, email and photo. This app sends them to no server of its own: they stay in your browser.
login.switch_to_local: No Google account? Create a local profile
login.storage_note: Everything is stored in this browser's localStorage. Signing out only removes the profile, not your movies.

night.start_hint: Creates a link with your filters and a seed: everyone who opens it draws the same movie.
night.active_hint: Everyone opening this link with these filters draws the same movie ("skip watched" is ignored). Changing filters breaks the sync.

backup.title: Your data (backup)
backup.description: Watched movies, draw history and presets live only in this browser. Export a file to move them to another device or keep them safe; importing merges without duplicates.
backup.invalid: That file is not a valid Cybercafé 24hs backup.

marathon.title: Marathon mode
marathon.description: Draw several movies at once to plan the night: all different, using your current filters (and the shared seed if one is active). They're saved to the history.
marathon.ends_at: Starting now you'd finish ~{{time}} (with 15 min breaks in between)
marathon.order_hint: Suggested order: longest first, while everyone is still awake.
marathon.empty: Nothing drawn yet. Pick how many movies you want above.
marathon.short: Only {{got}} of {{wanted}} distinct movies were found with these filters.
